blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization
blocks.note: The pipeline is measured end to end; each stage reports its own freshness and cost, which is what makes the unit economics arguable.

blocks.x: The architecture for Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization is deliberately auditable: every stage exposes its inputs, its owner and its failure policy, and the decision path shares a timeline with the audit path. Nothing important happens off the record.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
